notes: Builds the Crude Oil System Emme network batchin file. The two ArcGIS-exported .dbf inputs are replaced by inline DATA steps carrying the columns the program keeps (node_id/point_x/point_y/MESOZONE for nodes & centroids; inode/jnode/miles/modes/type/lanes/vdf for links). Output FILENAME rewritten from an absolute &outpath to a relative cos_ntwk.txt. The original 'where=(modes is null)' verification line uses the SAS-equivalent 'is missing'. PROC SORT/FREQ duplicate checks, PROC PRINT verifications and the batchin PUT statements are unchanged; the program writes a complete nodes+links Emme batchin file.
